pages.text: The $(l)Dark Matter Sword$() and $(l)Red Matter Sword$() are reliable weapons: twelve attack damage for Dark Matter and sixteen for Red Matter. Craft the Dark Matter Sword from Dark Matter and a diamond, then upgrade it into the Red Matter Sword.$(br2)Press $(l)V$() to charge, $(l)G$() to change the Red Matter Sword's target mode and $(l)C$() for its extra function.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)At a full attack bar, press $(l)C$() to strike every nearby hostile mob at once; the radius grows with charge.$(li)The Red Matter Sword's mode ($(l)G$()) can be set to $(l)Slay Hostile$() or $(l)Slay All$(), so its $(l)C$() strike can also hit passive mobs.$(li)The sword's sweep hits a wider area as charge rises.$(li)Charging adds bonus attack damage, but the extra hit no longer ignores armor in this version.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() none specific to the swords.
